fixes.change: Type-check both the app and Vite configuration explicitly.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: Login fixtures fail with 401, registration fixtures lack eligible Employee Master records, and local-backup configuration differs. These failures block the workflows from reaching their assertions.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Make seed settings and application initialization function-scoped; create eligible employee fixtures and explicitly configure optional modules.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: Tests expect pending_mfa while the existing deployment enables local test authentication bypass.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Set the intended authentication mode explicitly in each test instead of inheriting Docker configuration.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: V6 test expects Finance project creation to set a PM. Current service deliberately reserves PM assignment for BD.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Update the legacy test setup to assign the PM through the current authorized BD workflow.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: Some tests omit production correction before repeated review; others date correction sessions in October but record rejection at the current November time. The service rejects these with a correction-required error.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Use chronological rejection/correction/review timestamps and exercise the correction-completion step before repeating review; retain the current workflow guard.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: Fixtures use October 2026 targets with real current completion timestamps in November, but expect on-time completion.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Use explicit completion timestamps or a fixed test clock, then recheck deadline and productivity exports.

remaining_failure_analysis.evidence: Older tests expect sample notifications that the current obsolete-sample retirement behavior suppresses.
remaining_failure_analysis.next_step: Align legacy notification expectations with the documented current workflow and retain retirement regression coverage.

limitations: Browser access host was unavailable. Visual layout, interactive clicks, mobile layouts and browser console errors were not verified.
Frontend source-verification scripts do not substitute for interactive browser tests.
SMTP delivery, real external integrations, backup restore and deployment to cPanel were not exercised.
Backend mutation tests used isolated SQLite databases, not the live PostgreSQL database. Live smoke checks only read business data after login.
Vite still reports large JavaScript chunks; the main chunk is approximately 2.68 MB minified. Performance was not measured.
